events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place over three days in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: Remembering the peace, love, and music that defined a generation. It's 57 years since Woodstock. Which iconic performance is still giving you goosebumps?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on this day in 1977, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Forty-nine years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music still reigns supreme. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur died on this day in 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering a hip-hop icon today. Thirty years since we lost Tupac Shakur, his lyrical genius and impact on music are still felt worldwide.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, aged 27, leaving an indelible mark on rock music.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: 'Abbey Road' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on this day in 1969, featuring classic tracks like 'Something' and 'Come Together'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of 'Abbey Road'! That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tunes. Still a masterpiece. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Hynde's Rock Spirit
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders and proving that true rock 'n' roll never fades. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Mad for Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The definitive frontman, still bringing that swagger and those anthems. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic peace anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From classic cool to modern thrillers, 007 always delivers. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations around the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, he's a true British comedy legend.

events.title: 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from this iconic record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991, leaving an irreplaceable void in music.

angles.name: Freddie's Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legend – truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
